Thanks — tagging the step-by-step below so Neha can assemble in GH. I did a quick audit on GH permissions and approval flows this morning.

Greenhouse Offer Assembly + Approval Path (recommended):
1) Create Offer in Greenhouse: Candidate > Offers > New Offer. Select job: SWE III (Infra).
2) Populate financials: Base = 152000, Signing bonus = 15000 (prorated), Equity note = eligible for 2028 refresh; total OTE = 180k. Upload Kayla_Chen_offer_calc.xlsx to the offer record.
3) Set Offer Approvers (Greenhouse):
   - Hiring Manager (Marcus Lin) — Approval required
   - Recruiting Manager (Monica Patel) — Approval required
   - People Ops (Laura Bennett) — Approval required if base > 150k OR if any non-standard comp mix exists
   - Legal — Approval required only if adding special clauses (we are not adding any right now)
4) Add Offer Document: use conditional-offer-template.pdf as the base PDF. Add a short paragraph for target start date (week of May 24) and the contingency language (background + reference check).
5) Kick off approvals in GH: request approvals sequentially to keep audit trail clean (Marcus -> Monica -> Laura). Greenhouse will auto-notify once each approves.
6) After GH approvals complete, send DocuSign envelope using the DocuSign integration (link: https://docusign.example.com/envelope/ABCDEF123456). Use standard Redwood e-sign workflow and include the offer doc + eq grant letter stub if needed.

Timing notes / gotchas:
- If People Ops requests a comp exception request form, that adds ~24–48 hours.
- For above-band bases we often see an extra review cycle; to avoid delays start with the sequential approver flow rather than parallel.
- If candidate needs quicker turnaround, we can mark People Ops as "notify" instead of required, but that increases risk. Only do this with Exec approval.

I can open the GH offer now and set up the approvers; Neha, if you confirm the base & signing amounts I will create the record and kick off approvals.

-Monica
Recruiting Lead, Redwood Inference
